issues.title: As above, So below: a subsystem shut itself down after an error
issues.explanation: As above, So below wraps each of its systems - cross-level hauling, rendering, threats, movement and so on - in its own kill switch. When one throws an error it is logged once, that single system is turned off, and the rest of the mod plus vanilla keep running. The log line names the system, what it was doing, and often the likely cause (a specific item, mod or pawn). This error is contained by design; it is not a crash.
issues.fix: The affected feature stays off until it is re-armed. Open Mod settings > As above, So below and re-arm the tripped system, or reload your save (loading re-arms every system). If it keeps tripping, the 'Likely cause' in the log points at the culprit - report that line together with the stack trace.

keywords: shut itself down to protect your game

issues.title: As above, So below: cross-level logistics turned itself off
issues.explanation: The logistics system handles hauling and ferrying items between levels, storage capacity limits, demand pulls, and routing mechs to a charger on another level. It hit an error and shut down, so nothing will be carried, ferried or charged across levels until it is re-armed. The usual trigger is another storage or hauling mod (Pick Up And Haul, Hauler's Dream, LWM Deep Storage) or a modded mech or charger; the log's 'Likely cause' names the exact item or mod.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'logistics' in Mod settings > As above, So below, or reload the save. If it trips again, note the item or mod named as the likely cause and report it with the full log line and stack trace.

issues.title: As above, So below: cross-level movement turned itself off
issues.explanation: The movement system hands pawns between levels when they use stairs, elevators or ladders. It hit an error and shut down, so pawns will not path across levels until it is re-armed. This is usually triggered by a pathfinding or vehicle mod, or by a reservation conflict on the stair tile.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'movement' in Mod settings > As above, So below, or reload the save. If it keeps tripping, report the log line and stack trace, plus which movement or vehicle mods you run.

issues.title: As above, So below: cross-level interface extras turned themselves off
issues.explanation: The ui system draws the mod's interface additions: the level-view buttons and hotkeys, below-thing overlays, cross-level drag-box selection, colonist-bar ordering, the column alerts and the widened targeter. It hit an error and shut down, so those extras stop, though the vanilla interface is unaffected. It is usually triggered by another UI or HUD mod, or by a thing that throws while its overlay is drawn.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'ui' in Mod settings > As above, So below, or reload the save. If it keeps tripping, report the log line and stack trace, plus which UI, HUD or colonist-bar mods you run.

issues.title: As above, So below: the see-below view turned itself off
issues.explanation: The rendering system draws the live view of the surface beneath the sky, and the plumb view of the level below. It hit an error and shut down, so the below view may go blank while the column itself keeps working normally. It is usually triggered by a rendering, shader or camera mod, or by an object that throws while being drawn shrunk in the below view.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'rendering' in Mod settings > As above, So below, or reload the save. If it keeps tripping, report the log line and stack trace, plus which rendering or camera mods you run.

issues.title: As above, So below: cross-level combat turned itself off
issues.explanation: The combat system routes shooting and fighting between the sky and surface levels. It hit an error and shut down, so cross-level targeting and combat stop until it is re-armed. It is usually triggered by a combat overhaul such as Combat Extended, or by an unusual verb or projectile.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'combat' in Mod settings > As above, So below, or reload the save. If it keeps tripping, report the log line and stack trace, plus your combat mods (note if you run Combat Extended).

issues.title: As above, So below: roof syncing between levels turned itself off
issues.explanation: The roofSync system keeps the sky floor and the surface roof consistent - open air versus a mountain top overhead. It hit an error and shut down, so overhead and roof state between two levels may drift out of sync. It is usually triggered by a roofing or mining mod.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'roofSync' in Mod settings > As above, So below, or reload the save. If it keeps tripping, report the log line and stack trace, plus which roofing or mining mods you run.

issues.title: As above, So below: threat routing turned itself off
issues.explanation: The threats system sends raids, drop pods, infestations and visitors to the correct level of a column. It hit an error and shut down, so incidents may fall back to vanilla placement or land on the wrong level. It is usually triggered by a raid, incident or storyteller mod, or by a modded incident worker.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'threats' in Mod settings > As above, So below, or reload the save. If it keeps tripping, report the log line and stack trace, plus which incident, raid or storyteller mods you run.

issues.title: As above, So below: level generation turned itself off
issues.explanation: The levelGen system builds the extra sky and basement maps when a column is created or extended. It hit an error and shut down, so a column may not gain its extra levels until it is re-armed. It is usually triggered by a world generation, biome or terrain mod that conflicts during map creation.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'levelGen' in Mod settings > As above, So below, then generate or extend the column again, or reload the save. If it keeps tripping, report the log line and stack trace, plus your worldgen, biome and terrain mods.

issues.title: As above, So below: cross-level pipes turned themselves off
issues.explanation: The pipes system links fluid and gas pipe networks across the levels of a column, for mods such as Dubs Bad Hygiene, Rimefeller and Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded. It hit an error and shut down, so those pipe networks will not carry across levels until it is re-armed. The trigger is usually the pipe mod itself; the log's 'Likely cause' names it.
issues.fix: Re-arm 'pipes' in Mod settings > As above, So below, or reload the save. If it keeps tripping, note the pipe mod named as the likely cause and report it with the log line and stack trace.

issues.title: As above, So below: background rebuilds fell back to the main thread
issues.explanation: The async system builds the see-below mask on a background thread to keep the game smooth. Unlike the other systems, tripping it does not turn a feature off - it just falls back to building the mask synchronously on the main thread. The only symptom is a brief stutter when the below view updates. It is usually triggered by a threading or performance mod.
issues.fix: No action is needed; the below view still works, only less smoothly. To restore background rebuilds, re-arm 'async' in Mod settings > As above, So below or reload the save. RimThreaded is not supported. If it keeps tripping, report the log line and stack trace, plus your performance or threading mods.
